Subject: mydestination precedence over transport_maps

On my postfix 2.3 server 
I would like  mail for *.domain.com to get relayed to relayserver but
mail for home.domain.com to get relayed to lmtp 

In my main.cf 
---------
mydestination = home.domain.com
mailbox_transport = lmtp:unix:/var/imap/socket/lmtp
----------


and in my transport_maps I have 
--------
domain.com :[relayserver.domain.com]
--------

But the transport_maps takes precedence over mydestination. Can I tell
postfix to deliver mail for mydestination locally even if there is a
transport entry 



Thanks
Ram
